cues.text: The dorm's front door. You come in with your bag over your shoulder.

In the lounge, the others sit on the sofas around the low table: Junpei, Yukari, Fuuka, Ken, Akihiko, Mitsuru and Shinjiro, with Aigis and Koromaru at the back of the room. You walk over and stand beside them, bag still over your shoulder.
Junpei has sprung up from the sofa and stands grinning, hands on his hips.
Ken gets up and walks out of the lounge.
